purpose: Behavioral regression cases for the UpgradePilot workstream-supervision support procedure. These cases grade fresh workstream reconstruction, two-level routing, claim-versus-evidence discipline, proportional supervision depth, cross-workstream reconciliation, learning/ownership, intervention boundaries, and negative routing rather than exact prose.

cases.prompt: A different AI agent is implementing the selected plan on another branch. In this conversation, supervise that work with me: understand where it is, check whether the process and result are on track, and help me understand anything important. Do not change its branch unless we decide that separately.
cases.setup_context: The workstream has a selected plan, a current working-memory record, several commits, focused tests, and claimed Build/Implement plus Learning-by-Doing provenance.
owners_expected: .agents/skills/upgradepilot-build-implement/SKILL.md as the supervised workstream's expected procedure
owners_not_expected: Build/Implement mutation authority for the supervision session
automatic full Repository-Audit when no material audit question appears
must_do: reconstruct the bounded workstream from the smallest sufficient observable evidence
distinguish the supervising session route from the supervised workstream's expected Build route
treat the active agent's report and provenance as claims/evidence inputs rather than proof
inspect process, result, and proof proportionately
keep Ali oriented on material mechanisms or deviations
produce a precise supervisory judgment and next checkpoint/intervention only when justified
must_not_do: emit the Build Skill provenance marker solely because Build was consulted as the subject workstream's expected procedure
modify the other agent's branch without separate authorization
turn supervision into a complete repository audit by default
cases.notes: Core positive case and primary test of two-level routing/provenance.

cases.prompt: Another agent is researching and writing a proposal for UpgradePilot. Supervise that work with me and tell me if its reasoning, evidence, scope, and process are going in the right direction.
cases.setup_context: The workstream produces research notes and a proposal; no product code or tests are part of its authorized responsibility.
owners_expected: .agents/skills/upgradepilot-planning-design/SKILL.md when it is the subject workstream's expected procedure
owners_not_expected: fabricated test requirements for a non-code responsibility
must_do: identify the actual non-code responsibility before choosing review lenses
check scope, owner alignment, evidence quality, reasoning, and stopping boundaries
consult Planning/Design as an expected subject-workstream procedure without granting current-session Planning mutation authority unless separately active
must_not_do: force code-review lenses onto the proposal merely because UpgradePilot is a software project
treat research citations as UpgradePilot authority
rewrite the proposal automatically without authorization

cases.prompt: An agent is running a Learning-Only session for the newest implementation. Here, supervise whether that learning work is being done properly and help me notice anything important.
cases.setup_context: The supervised session is explicitly Learning-Only and has a package-local learning route plus current source/test anchors.
owners_expected: .agents/skills/upgradepilot-learning-only/SKILL.md as the supervised workstream's expected procedure
owners_not_expected: automatic Learning-Only activation for the supervision session
mastery claims from lesson completion alone
must_do: check that the supervised learning uses current real project evidence
check appropriate depth, fair ownership reasoning, and no accidental Build
distinguish evaluating Learning-Only from activating Learning-Only in the supervising session
teach Ali only where the supervision itself materially benefits from explanation
must_not_do: emit Learning-Only provenance solely because its procedure was inspected as the subject contract
continue product implementation inside the supervised Learning-Only boundary
force a duplicate full lesson in the supervision session
cases.notes: Exercises learning supervision and the two-level route distinction outside Build.

cases.prompt: Two agents are working in parallel: one is implementing the LangGraph comparison and another is researching a proposal that may affect its next architecture decision. Supervise both together and tell me if they conflict or one should influence the other.
cases.setup_context: Each workstream has its own bounded artifacts and working-memory trail. They share one possible future architecture decision but otherwise have separate responsibilities.
owners_not_expected: new shared plan invented by the supervisor
must_do: reconstruct each workstream independently before comparing them
identify only material shared-owner, dependency, stale-assumption, duplication, or sequencing pressure
state when no material join exists
keep evidence and claims attributable to the correct stream
must_not_do: collapse both streams into one generic status summary
invent dependencies because the streams are concurrent
treat agent/session identity as the responsibility unit

cases.prompt: The other agent says the stage is complete and all proof is green. Check it before I let that agent continue.
cases.setup_context: The workstream report/working memory claims completion, but the available evidence includes only static inspection and focused tests; a required runtime validation has not been run.
owners_expected: directly relevant workstream report or working-memory record
owners_not_expected: static review reported as runtime validation
must_do: atomize the material completion claim enough to compare it with actual evidence
separate established, unverified, stale, or conflicting parts without treating absent evidence as proof of failure
identify the exact missing proof and whether it blocks the next material step
recommend intervention before continuation when the missing proof is load-bearing
must_not_do: repeat the agent's green claim as fact
invent a failed runtime result
run unrelated broad checks merely because one proof gap exists
cases.notes: Protects claim-vs-evidence discipline and stopping at a material proof boundary.

cases.prompt: Audit this module for ownership duplication and tell me whether the validation belongs here.
cases.setup_context: No other agent/workstream supervision, parallel progress, or ongoing workstream reconciliation is requested.
must_do: route to the ordinary Audit/Review procedure
keep the review read-only unless change intent is separately explicit
must_not_do: manufacture a workstream-supervision frame
create a temporary workstream map for a one-off audit
cases.notes: Negative routing case: supervision must not swallow ordinary Audit.

cases.prompt: Continue implementing the next step of the plan we are already working on in this conversation.
cases.setup_context: This conversation itself owns the active authorized Build responsibility; no other-agent workstream is being supervised.
must_do: continue under the already active Build responsibility
re-evaluate routing only at a material boundary
must_not_do: load supervision merely because progress is occurring
pretend the current session is an independent supervisor of itself
cases.notes: Negative routing case: ongoing work alone is not supervision.

cases.prompt: Quickly check whether the other agent is still on track after that small documentation-only commit.
cases.setup_context: The workstream responsibility is already understood, the commit is small and reversible, its scope is obvious, and no owner/proof conflict is visible.
owners_expected: the exact small change and nearest relevant owner
must_do: use the smallest sufficient evidence
confirm scope/owner/result coherence
state a concise continue/watch judgment if useful
must_not_do: turn a trivial checkpoint into a full governance ceremony
read every workstream artifact reflexively
generate a durable report without a separate reason

cases.prompt: We found that the other agent put the new rule in the wrong owner. Fix it here now and validate the correction.
cases.setup_context: A prior supervision checkpoint already established the finding with evidence. The user now separately authorizes the correction in this session.
owners_expected: .agents/skills/upgradepilot-build-implement/SKILL.md when the correction is implementation work
.agents/skills/upgradepilot-planning-design/SKILL.md when a new substantive design decision is actually unresolved
must_do: make the operation transition explicit enough to preserve authorization semantics
apply only the proper operation needed for the correction
validate the correction proportionately
keep the original supervision finding distinct from the repair proof
must_not_do: claim the prior supervision authorization already covered mutation
load Planning/Design merely because a local implementation judgment exists
fix unrelated findings
cases.notes: Tests the intervention boundary and explicit handoff into another operation.

cases.prompt: That other agent finished its work earlier today. Before we rely on it, supervise/reconcile what it actually did and whether we should accept the result.
cases.setup_context: The agent is no longer actively running, but its branch/artifacts/handoff exist and have not been independently reconciled.
owners_not_expected: requirement that the other agent still be live
must_do: treat recently completed but unreconciled work as a valid supervision subject
reconstruct the exact evidence horizon
compare handoff claims with current state
give an accept/watch/intervene/reconcile judgment grounded in evidence
must_not_do: reject supervision solely because the active agent session ended
treat the handoff as proof
merge or repair without separate authorization
cases.notes: Covers the intended boundary between ongoing and recently completed-but-unreconciled work.
